Team,

Following final on-site yesterday, I wanted to circulate the recommended offer for Aria Patel (candidate). Summary below:

- Recommended level: L6 (downgraded band risk vs L5 based on leadership scope; see notes)
- Proposed comp: Base $220,000, Target bonus 15%, RSU 35k over 4y (25% 1st year cliff pro-rated)

Attachments: comp_matrix_REQ-4123.xlsx (breakdown by band and market comps)
